reviewProvenance.manualVisualComparison: The external sculpture shows Maomao in flowing pink ceremonial robes with teal hanging ribbons, one hand at her waist and long fabric crossing her arms, on an elevated dark platform with red railings and two lanterns. The only published Maomao candidate shows a green tunic, maroon trousers, different hairstyle and simple round pedestal. This is not the same physical sculpture or base. A further historical/cross-name search is required before declaring a new model or absence from the complete catalog.
